scope: Existing development split only; 24 independent base families; no fresh diagnostic or original confirmation evaluation.
encoder: I-JEPA; raw encoder features versus frozen 128-dimensional reader projection
primary_findings: All 12 genuinely supervised probes (6 local targets x raw/projected) decode every old-DEV observation correctly, including salient and nonsalient groups. Both class recalls are 1. All selected real-label lambda values are 100, selected solely on VAL.

All 12 current-blank controls yield balanced accuracy 0.5 in every reported nonsingle-family group; individual class recalls can be asymmetric because predictions are constant within a balanced local-target family.

Fixed shuffled-label controls are not uniformly at chance. Projected R_b reaches family-balanced 0.75 overall and 0.9167 for salient cues. Raw/projected S_payload reaches approximately 0.6042/0.5833 overall. Report these controls without rerandomization.

The fixed TRAIN permutation preserves marginal label counts, but small correlations with genuine local categories remain. R_b salient shuffled/genuine labels agree on 52/96 rows (0.5417); S_payload nonsalient agrees on 110/192 (0.5729). A thresholded linear predictor can amplify such small type-linked signs on this discrete vocabulary. This is a possible explanation, not a unique causal proof of the observed shuffled-probe scores.

Shuffled models also use genuine VAL labels for the prespecified lambda selection. Their family-bootstrap CI is conditional on this one shuffle and fit; it is not a permutation-null interval or a p-value.
supported_interpretation: For these old-DEV cue images, task-specific linear readouts can recover all tested local axis-payload bits, S payload bits, and S tags from both raw I-JEPA and frozen projected features.
This evidence strongly disfavors loss of those local binary labels in the visual encoder/projection as the explanation of the archived salient-cue and tag-related reader errors.
Reader-side aggregation, downstream decoding, action interactions, optimization, or training coverage remain candidate explanations; the planned reader interventions must distinguish them.
not_established: Perfect local decoding does not show that the dynamics reader can discover which two tags match, compute their XOR, or use those bits with the correct actions and time semantics.
These are head-specific supervised probes with known task/axis diagnostic grouping, not a single deployable parser for arbitrary scenes.
Local labels are accessible before pooling; preservation of relational information after aggregation was not probed here.
The audit does not isolate softmax as the unique cause, establish universal feature sufficiency, or justify changing an already frozen experiment.
The fresh diagnostic is unopened; old DEV has only 24 independent families. Salient D heads involve 12 families and salient S heads 18.
Bootstrap intervals [1,1] for zero observed errors and [0.5,0.5] for balanced blank controls are empirical resampling results, not proof of perfect population generalization.
analysis_actions: Read saved artifacts, verify hashes/permutation/counts, recompute selected-model normal equations and saved-prediction metrics. No refit, checkpoint selection, source/config/preregistration changes, or fresh-scene evaluation.
